Chassis_Frame.title: Monocoque Chassis Frame
Chassis_Frame.description: CNC-machined 7075-T6 aluminium spine: twin longitudinal rails tied by two bulkheads that carry the four hip-abduction actuators. All internal modules bolt to this frame.

Skid_Plate.title: Titanium Skid Plate
Skid_Plate.description: Ventral armour plate. Protects the battery and hydraulic manifold when the robot parks or belly-lands on rough terrain.

Top_Cover.title: Dorsal Service Cover
Top_Cover.description: Glass-fibre reinforced PA12 cover with integral cargo deck, vent louvres for the power electronics and twin grab rails. Removes with six captive fasteners for field service.

Side_Panel_L.title: Side Armour Panel (L)
Side_Panel_L.description: Impact-resistant side armour. The dark inset is a quick-release access hatch to the battery bay.

Side_Panel_R.title: Side Armour Panel (R)
Side_Panel_R.description: Impact-resistant side armour. The dark inset is a quick-release access hatch to the battery bay.

Battery_Pack.title: 48 V Li-ion Battery Pack
Battery_Pack.description: 63-cell 21700 pack in 13S5P configuration with nickel-copper bus bars and an integrated battery-management board that balances cells and reports state-of-charge over CAN-FD.

Power_Core.title: Power Distribution Core
Power_Core.description: Supercapacitor buffer and high-current distribution node. Absorbs regenerative braking energy from the actuators; its indicator column shows bus charge state.

Hydraulic_Pump.title: Hydraulic Power Unit
Hydraulic_Pump.description: Brushless motor driving an axial-piston pump. Supplies the four knee actuators through a proportional valve manifold at up to 21 MPa.

Hydraulic_Reservoir.title: Pressurised Oil Reservoir
Hydraulic_Reservoir.description: Bootstrap reservoir holding 0.4 L of ISO VG 32 fluid with an amber sight-glass for level checks.

Hydraulic_Lines.title: High-Pressure Hose Set
Hydraulic_Lines.description: Four-wire braided hoses routing pressure and return lines from the manifold to the rotary swivels at each hip.

Gearbox_Plate.title: Accessory Gearbox Plate
Gearbox_Plate.description: Bearing plate for the accessory gear train that drives the cooling fan and auxiliary pump.

Gear_Drive.title: Drive Pinion
Gear_Drive.description: Spur gear in the accessory train (module 4 mm, 20° pressure angle). Gear speeds are kinematically coupled by tooth count in the animation.

Gear_Idler.title: Idler Gear
Gear_Idler.description: Spur gear in the accessory train (module 4 mm, 20° pressure angle). Gear speeds are kinematically coupled by tooth count in the animation.

Gear_Output.title: Output Gear
Gear_Output.description: Spur gear in the accessory train (module 4 mm, 20° pressure angle). Gear speeds are kinematically coupled by tooth count in the animation.

Cooling_Duct.title: Cooling Duct & Radiator
Cooling_Duct.description: Rear plenum with a finned heat exchanger for the hydraulic oil and power electronics. Air is pulled through by the axial fan.

Cooling_Fan_Rotor.title: Axial Cooling Fan
Cooling_Fan_Rotor.description: 7-blade 120 mm axial fan, PWM-controlled from coolant temperature.

Control_Computer.title: Compute & Motor-Control Board
Control_Computer.description: Real-time controller (1 kHz whole-body control loop) with a GPU module for perception. Talks to all 18 actuators over EtherCAT.

Cable_Harness.title: EtherCAT / Power Harness
Cable_Harness.description: Shielded daisy-chain harness carrying 48 V power and EtherCAT to each leg and the sensor head.

Sensor_Head.title: Perception Head
Sensor_Head.description: Sealed sensor housing with a dark glass visor. Carries the stereo depth cameras, a structured-light projector, status lighting and twin 5G/Wi-Fi antennas.

Stereo_Cameras.title: Stereo Depth Cameras
Stereo_Cameras.description: Global-shutter stereo pair (120 mm baseline) with an IR dot projector for depth in low light.

Lidar_Base.title: Lidar Mount
Lidar_Base.description: Vibration-isolated lidar mount with slip ring.

Lidar_Rotor.title: 360° Lidar
Lidar_Rotor.description: 32-channel spinning lidar used for SLAM mapping and obstacle avoidance.

Arm_Slew_Bearing.title: Turret Slew Bearing
Arm_Slew_Bearing.description: Crossed-roller slew ring that carries the arm's moment loads into the chassis.

Hip_Abd_Motor_FL.title: Hip Abduction Actuator (FL)
Hip_Abd_Motor_FL.description: Frameless torque motor with a 9:1 cycloidal reducer. Swings the leg sideways for lateral balance and turning.

Hip_Yoke_FL.title: Hip Yoke (FL)
Hip_Yoke_FL.description: Forged bridge bracket on the abduction output flange. It straddles the thigh hub and carries the hip-pitch servo on its outboard cheek.

Hip_Pitch_Servo_FL.title: Hip Pitch Servo (FL)
Hip_Pitch_Servo_FL.description: High-torque servo with strain-wave gearing; swings the thigh fore and aft and provides most of the propulsive work during the trot.

Thigh_FL.title: Upper Leg (FL)
Thigh_FL.description: Hollow carbon-composite box beam with a titanium-reinforced outboard cap. Carries the hydraulic knee cylinder's front clevis.

Knee_Bearing_FL.title: Knee Bearing Assembly (FL)
Knee_Bearing_FL.description: Preloaded tapered-roller bearing pair with double-lip seals; the knee is the most heavily loaded joint during landing.

Shin_FL.title: Lower Leg & Damper (FL)
Shin_FL.description: Tapered aluminium tube with an integral coil-over damper that absorbs foot-strike impacts. The heel lever above the knee transfers hydraulic force into knee torque.

Foot_FL.title: Foot Pad (FL)
Foot_FL.description: Over-moulded polyurethane foot with a six-axis force/torque sensor in the ankle collar for contact detection.

Arm_Turret.title: Arm Turret
Arm_Turret.description: Rotating base of the manipulator. Its single-sided cheek carries the shoulder actuator so the forearm can fold flat beside the upper arm when stowed.

Shoulder_Actuator.title: Shoulder Actuator
Shoulder_Actuator.description: Strain-wave servo lifting the whole arm. Sized for a 5 kg payload at full reach.

Arm_Upper.title: Upper Arm Link
Arm_Upper.description: Hollow PA12-CF link with an internal cable channel. Elbow motor bolts to its distal end.

Elbow_Actuator.title: Elbow Actuator
Elbow_Actuator.description: Through-shaft elbow servo; the forearm runs beside the upper arm on its output flange.

Arm_Forearm.title: Forearm Link
Arm_Forearm.description: Lightweight forearm with an embedded wrist cable loom.

Wrist_Pitch_Servo.title: Wrist Pitch Servo
Wrist_Pitch_Servo.description: Compact servo that pitches the end effector.

Wrist_Housing.title: Wrist Roll Module
Wrist_Housing.description: Continuous-rotation wrist roll drive with a slip ring - the gripper can spin endlessly.

Gripper_Palm.title: Parallel Gripper Body
Gripper_Palm.description: Lead-screw parallel gripper: one motor drives a left/right-hand screw so both fingers close symmetrically on linear rails. A camera between the fingers guides the final approach.

Gripper_Finger_L.title: Gripper Finger (L)
Gripper_Finger_L.description: Aluminium finger with a replaceable silicone friction pad.

Gripper_Finger_R.title: Gripper Finger (R)
Gripper_Finger_R.description: Aluminium finger with a replaceable silicone friction pad.

Work_Stand.title: Work Stand
Work_Stand.description: Steel test stand used for the pick-and-place demonstration.

Sample_Crate.title: Sample Crate (2 kg)
Sample_Crate.description: Ruggedised 120 mm sample container used in the object-interaction demo.

Knee_Cylinder_FL.title: Knee Hydraulic Cylinder (FL)
Knee_Cylinder_FL.description: Double-acting hydraulic cylinder that drives the knee through the heel lever - the 'quadriceps' of the leg. Its rod extends as the knee straightens.

Knee_Rod_FL.title: Knee Piston Rod (FL)
Knee_Rod_FL.description: Hard-chromed piston rod with a spherical-bearing rod eye pinned to the heel lever.

Knee_Cylinder_FR.description: Double-acting hydraulic cylinder that drives the knee through the heel lever - the 'quadriceps' of the leg. Its rod extends as the knee straightens.
